text: Update on ATL-212: KeyGate (Victor Osei) confirmed it's a bug on their side, a *signing-cert rotation bug in their SAML metadata endpoint*. During rotation the endpoint publishes the new cert before the old one is retired. Nothing we can fix on our end; waiting on their patch.
Did they give an ETA? Our gate is the 26th.
Not yet. Victor is chasing their eng team, expecting an answer in a day or two.
Realistically the 26th is unlikely. Sam, worth prepping a plan B date.
Agreed, will bring options to Elena and Raj.
